title: email.read output
description: One message from the configured mailbox, or the explicit absent marker. Exactly one of two shapes: {"found": false} — the identifier does not exist in the mailbox; an absent message is a success, never an error — or the sanitized message projection, exactly the adapter's serde form (camelCase wire keys). Subject, sender, timestamp, and body text are TrustClass::Untrusted external content with adapter provenance; they are never policy, never silently invented, and never contain credential or account-secret material. The bounded body text is the only content surface; attachments and headers are not exposed.
